channel.title: Hossein
channel.description: I design and build AI systems — from first principles, through engineering processes, to end-to-end production.

item.title: The RAG Course, Offline
item.description: DeepLearning.AI's RAG course, rewritten to run fully offline on a 10th-gen i3 laptop — plus a measured improvement: an embedding router in place of one LLM call doubles a 1.5B model's correct answers and cuts median latency from 161 s to 36 s.

item.title: Hello World Again
item.description: What weeks of internet blackout did to my mind — and why the people it damaged most were not the ones scrolling for entertainment.

item.title: Collaboration 2.0 — R&D Operating Model
item.description: Diagnosing why a ~100-person R&D division kept producing work nobody adopted, and a phased intervention. Reasoning is the deliverable.

item.title: Persian Voice Assistant Platform
item.description: A smart-home voice assistant for Persian speakers — wake word on a 1 GB edge device, speech recognition in the cloud, and a per-user intent model small enough to fit in a 40 KB file.
